ValidationRule.description: The Customer ID field and Account field on a case is required before the case moves to In Progress.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = "NAS General Support Case", ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress"), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLank(Customer_ID__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account and Customer ID fields are required for a case to be In Progress.
